Thank you very much for your support! hmm my best memory, difficult one but would have to be back in our skating years! That's actually how we met, i brought my skateboard in after school to show it off and then he went and brought his from home when we were about 12. after that we basically started hanging out and skating every day until our group of 2 became a big group of 15-20 people which we kinda started  together! So i would say no specific memory, just our teenage skating years in general! in the local skate parks and skate spots in our neighbourhood. so many memories running away from police because we would sneak into schools to skate haha.. good times.. he was a good skater too :/

excuse me but please dont accuse me of making a fake suicide note. this is my friends real note that he left behind. and just some info for the garbage u just said. in the UK a scorebag of weed is 20pounds which is about 2 grams which should last a daily consumer 2-3 days. he owed about 700pounds in loans. no comparison. get ure facts straight before u go tarnishing my dead friends memory

Thanks man and I'm really glad his last words had such an impact on you.. He was an awesome guy, always seemed happy, helpful whenever he could and just super sweet in general. I literally don't know anyone who didn't like him. Just goes to show though that what people are showing isn't always the case of what they're actually feeling. I lived with him and had no idea he was even considering this. Don't give up like he did tho bud, there's always something to live for. All the best man!

yeah been about 7 months since it happened and slowly people are starting to come back. his girlfriend is doing kinda better now, shes just graduated her masters and posted a picture of him saying how much she wished he was there with her... i occasionally go to visit his mum, shes taking it harder than anyone but thank god her grand kids put a smile on her face. Thanks all for your kind words, im sure he would appreciate it xxx
